rationale: A shuffled negative control can prove dependence on learned artifact organization only after the unshuffled artifact passes the locked reference-adequacy gate. Shuffling an already failing artifact and observing another failure is non-informative. Deferring that control changes no promotion gate and authorizes no claim.
failure_attribution_rule: The LayerCake host may be blamed only when the exact sealed native positive control fails. A passing native host and same-path control followed by inadequate candidate quality is ABI_EXTRACTION_FAILURE. A reference-adequate ABI artifact that fails only after installation is ABI_LAYERCAKE_INTEGRATION_FAILURE.
